localChanges: chore: work towards a 3D map, not offered yet: under ?3d=1 with the realistic sets, Dragoons stand, trot, fire their carbines from the saddle and go over with their horses with their own clips (#1425)

log: The Dragoons are generated again, standing (the Meshy community model galloped), his arms out clear of the reins and saddle, and its community credit goes: the set has four credits, and its credit line, LICENSE.md, package.json and the README say so.

He carries a carbine, the Musketmen's musket scaled down to 1.15 m with its bayonet fixed, in his right fist at the advance, its butt on his thigh. He's rigged as the Cavalry are: he idles, trots and falls with his horse onto its right side, and in his fight he brings the carbine to his shoulder, aims a little right of his horse's head and fires a bullet at 0.54 s.
